CheckTitle: Ensure IP-Based Filtering with WAF for SaaS is Enforced
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Oracle SaaS Operations service request records
Description: WAF for SaaS IP filtering should allow only trusted public IPs or CIDR ranges, enabled through a service request.
Risk: Without it the application is exposed to scanning and brute force from any address.
AuditProcedure: Find the service request enabling IP filtering; confirm the allowlist has no broad ranges such as 0.0.0.0/0; test from allowed and disallowed IPs.

Steps: Raise a service request with approved ranges, remove broad entries and verify UI and API access.
